verdict.rationale: The API is clearly versioned: its endpoints and public OpenAPI document live under an explicit /api/v3/ path, which implies a versioning scheme with prior major versions. No evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or how versions are retired, and versioning itself is only inferred from URL paths rather than described in docs. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit versioning documentation (version lifecycle, changelog, support windows), and independent corroboration.
